records.title: XunZi, an AI biologist, reveals disease-modifying targets

scope.decision_rationale: This is a new named model, XunZi, that integrates biomedical publications, structured biological corpora, and multimodal omics data to generate disease-target hypotheses. The text reasoning module is central and is fused with the biological graph model, so the text-bio bridge is substantive.
scope.evidence_snippet: "continual pretraining was performed using 24,411,924 curated biomedical publications"; "constructed a CoT instruction-based corpus"; "integrates logical reasoning and multimodal data fusion"; "harness both the semantic reasoning capacity of large language models and the contextual molecular knowledge embedded in omics-informed biological graphs"

architecture.decision_rationale: The paper introduces XunZi as a new hybrid AI biologist, not just a wrapper, and explicitly says it can “generate de novo therapeutic target hypotheses.” It is built from a 7.3B Mistral 7B LLM with continual pretraining on 24.4M publications and broad biomedical data.
architecture.evidence_snippet: “generate de novo therapeutic target hypotheses”; “selected a leading 7.3-B-parameter LLM, Mistral 7B”; “continual pretraining was performed using 24,411,924 curated biomedical publications”
